xBRIEFInfo.description: Bug cohort story for GitHub issue #3235 (operator-approved swarm 2026-08-10).

plan.title: fix(review): invalidate merge approval when PR HEAD changes under auto-merge

narratives.Description: A human merge approval bound to an earlier PR head can remain operational after the PR head changes when GitHub auto-merge was already enabled. Under requireHumanMerge, approval should authorize one reviewed immutable PR head; retaining auto-merge across head changes silently widens authorization.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator under requireHumanMerge, I want head-bound merge approval invalidated when PR HEAD changes, so that auto-merge cannot land a different head than the one approved.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Bind Phase 5/human merge approval to exact head SHA in Directive-owned state (prefer finish-loop / pr-wait-mergeable / policy require-human-merge path). On HEAD change: detect approved_head_sha != current_head_sha, fail closed with recovery instructions, and either disable pending auto-merge or require a new approval event for the current head before merge. Add tests covering auto-merge remaining enabled across subsequent pushes. Cite #3235 in CHANGELOG. Do not change consumer repository rulesets. Avoid editing packages/core/src/pr-merge-readiness/ci-gate.ts (owned by #3234).
narratives.Overview: fix(review): invalidate merge approval when PR HEAD changes under auto-merge
narratives.NonGoals: Epic #3237 children; docs-only mitigation; changing consumer repo rulesets.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Three acceptance items cover fix, fail-closed gate, and regression tests for this single-issue bug.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a recorded approval for head A, when PR HEAD becomes B, merge gates treat approval as stale and fail closed.
Given stale approval with auto-merge enabled, when the gate runs, it disables auto-merge or blocks merge until a new approval bound to current HEAD exists, with recovery text.
Given fixtures for multi-push auto-merge retention, when vitest runs finish-loop/pr-wait-mergeable/policy suites, cases pass; CHANGELOG cites #3235.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/finish-loop packages/core/src/pr-wait-mergeable packages/core/src/policy
